Engineering the future of healthcare, one university at a time. 🩺⚙️

Invention Education at Kenyatta University (IvE) was at the The Technical University of Kenya for the Annual General Meeting of the @Association of Engineering, Construction and Architecture Students (AECAS-TUK). 🎓

The afternoon opened with a keynote from the university administration, followed by the signing of an MoU between AECAS and Norwa Africa. 

Then came our hour. Representing IvE, Stacy Awinja , MIEEE introduced the MSc in Medical Device Innovation, along with the Design Challenges, Summer Program, and Catalyst Grants that are open to students from any university. 💡
Thank you, AECAS-TUK TUK, for the warm welcome. Here is to more bridges between universities. 🤝

Kenyatta University Rice University The Lemelson Foundation MedTech Kenyatta University Stacy Awinja , MIEEE Eubrea Mitchy

New month, new sawdust.

Yesterday, MSc Biomedical Engineering (MDI) Cohort 2 kicked off October with their first  woodworking class. First cuts, first joints, first feel of building something with their own hands.

Here is to a month of building.

Kenyatta University Rice University The Lemelson Foundation MedTech Kenyatta University Eubrea Mitchy Anthonius Waka
#InventionEducationKU #MedTechAfrica #KenyattaUniversity #MDI #Woodworking #Prototyping

Today at CDIE, a group of innovators gathered for a hands-on 3D printing workshop, moving from digital design to physical prototype. Students, interns, and builders at different stages of their journeys came to learn the craft of turning a concept into something you can hold, test, and improve.

With the right tools and the talent, together we will bring Ideas to objects one layer at a time.
